stories.title: Find available meeting rooms
stories.story: As an employee, I want to find available rooms that fit my meeting so I can choose a room to reserve.
acceptance_criteria: The employee can search by date, time slot, and minimum capacity.
Each result shows the name and capacity of an available room.
When no room matches, a message asks the employee to change the search.

sources.quote:
Employees search by date, time slot, and minimum capacity.
Results show only available rooms and display each room's name and capacity.
If no room matches, the results show a message asking the employee to change the search.

stories.title: Reserve a meeting room
stories.story: As an employee, I want to reserve an available room so I can plan my meeting.
acceptance_criteria: An employee can reserve a room from the search results.
A successful reservation shows the room name, date, and time slot.
If the room was just reserved by someone else, a message appears and the employee can return to the search results.

sources.quote:
An employee can reserve a room from the search results.
The confirmation shows the room name, date, and time slot.
If someone else reserves the room first, the employee sees a message and can return to the results.

stories.title: Cancel my reservation
stories.story: As an employee, I want to cancel a room I no longer need so someone else can reserve it.
acceptance_criteria: An employee can cancel their own reservation two hours or more before the start time.
A successful cancellation makes the room available again for that time slot.

sources.quote:
Employees can cancel their own reservations at least two hours before the start time.
When a reservation is cancelled, the room becomes available again for that time slot.

open_questions: For the reminder in source.md line 24, how far in advance should employees be reminded and through which channel?
